// diagnostic

E0942

This declaration writes markers both above it and inside its body

What

This declaration writes markers both above it and inside its body

Why

A declaration's markers are one set, written in one place, so a reader finds all of them together

Fix

Move every marker above the declaration, or every marker into its body as `#X: value` lines; `jet fix` moves them above.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0942: tests/ui/marker_inbody/mixing_above_and_inside.stderr.

Error [jet.MarkersAboveAndInside]: Struct `Pixel` writes markers both above it and inside its body
  --> tests/ui/marker_inbody/mixing_above_and_inside.jet:4:5
    |
  4 |     #Layout: c
    |     ^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A declaration's markers are one set, written in one place, so a reader finds all of them together
 Fix: Move every marker above struct `Pixel`, or every marker into its body as `#X: value` lines
